title: pilosella atramentaria subsp. erubescens
intro: Pilosella atramentaria subsp. erubescens, commonly known as False Salsify or Red Salsify, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae) and is native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a promising natural remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella atramentaria subsp. erubescens include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial actions, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce oxidative stress, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit significant biological activity.
